definitions.explanation: overseeing and directing affairs, especially of a property or estate
a person who manages property on behalf of the owner (historical/traditional usage)

notes:
USAGE:
- {差配|さはい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to manage, to supervise)
- {差配|さはい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}される (to be entrusted with management)
- {差配|さはい}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (manager, agent)

SENSE 2 (Historical):
In the Edo period and early modern Japan, {差配|さはい} or {差配人|さはいにん} referred to property managers who acted on behalf of landlords. This usage appears in historical fiction and period dramas.

MODERN EQUIVALENTS:
- ⟦{管理人|かんりにん}→管理人：03047_kanrinin⟧ (building manager)
- {不動産管理|ふどうさんかんり}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ (property management company)
